trend.title: Salesforce announces plans to acquire Cresta, a provider of AI-powered contact center automation software
trend.rationale: Salesforce's acquisition of Cresta highlights the growing emphasis on AI in CRM and customer engagement, key areas for retention marketing. This move could enhance Salesforce's offerings, impacting strategies around lifecycle messaging and customer data management.

evidence.support: Multiple reputable sources, including TechCrunch, report on the acquisition.

recent_news.headline: Salesforce to expand AI capabilities with Cresta acquisition.

risks: Integration challenges between Salesforce and Cresta technologies.
Potential regulatory scrutiny or antitrust issues.

trend.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
trend.rationale: Trajectory's funding round signifies a shift towards democratizing AI model training. This development could empower more businesses in the APAC region to leverage AI for retention marketing without needing technical expertise.

evidence.claim: Trajectory raised $45M for AI model training solutions.
evidence.support: The funding round is covered by TechCrunch, indicating credibility.

recent_news.headline: Trajectory secures funding to democratize AI model training.

risks: Potential overestimation of nontechnical users' ability to effectively train AI models.
Market competition from established AI platforms.

recent_news.headline: Google launches Dreambeans in India for AI-driven personalization.

Potential data privacy concerns with AI-generated content.
